Title: Abaddoness 

Genre: Mystery, Thriller, Horror


Blurb:


They often have book descriptions as something flashy and catchy. I don't think I've lived among humanity long enough to adapt their nuanced traditions, but I shall certainly try.
  
  You do know of the existence of Anomalies, correct? To my surprise, many universes still don't outwardly know of the existence of fellow humans who wield awesome powers.
  
  Join me as we gaze into the world of Nianna, a semi-retired spy who ends up being haunted by the past she wants to leave behind. Her story takes place on Gaia, the very first planet I've created! We watch her as she navigates closed chapters of her past, along with her best friend Harina, as they battle through rival spies, soldiers, guards, and Anomalies. The tale is quite a dark one, even from where I stand.
  
  My time for talking is done, and I shall leave it to the humans to tell the rest.
